plainTranslation: Their Sun in your 6th house: they energize your routines, work, and health; you get more done and take better care of yourself around them. Failure mode: the bond becomes all logistics. Let them help; don't reduce it to usefulness.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
